note: Manufacturer-specific motorcycle DTC dictionaries (MIL blink / dIAG codes) with OBD2 P-code cross-reference, transcribed from AutotronicCommunity/dtc_honda and AutotronicCommunity/dtc-yamaha (public HTML tables, cited; upstream wording is Indonesian). Reference/lookup only - reading and clearing DTCs stays gated by each ECU profile's capabilities. License policy: source repositories are treated as open for use and modification whether or not a license is stated; if an author advises otherwise, this transcription can be modified or removed then.
sources: https://github.com/AutotronicCommunity/Protokol-Diagnostik-PGMFI-Honda-Bike (PROTOKOL DIAKNOSTIK HONDA.png, 3-byte DTC layout of queries 73/74)
